img.caption: Fig 2: Main results across CLINC150 / MixATIS / MixSNIPS. Left: Macro-F1; right: set-level Jaccard. TECP-14B wins on CLINC150 single-label accuracy (0.948) but degrades on multi-intent benchmarks; SetFit+MC attains the best MixATIS Macro-F1 (0.497) yet collapses on CLINC150 set IoU (0.190). QP-10-shot trails on both. Ours (red) achieves the best MixSNIPS Macro-F1 (0.776) and the best set IoU on MixSNIPS (0.757) with tight, calibrated sets, no task-specific training.
